text: 1.Objective: Students in this program receive systematical training in theories, research, design and manufacturing methods of traditional Chinese medicine and natural medicine. Graduates work in such fields as manufacturing, identification and analysis of TCM, as well as pharmacology and biotechnology.2.Degree Requirements: Students in this program spend the first 2 years studying the basic sciences, biology and chemistry courses. In the first semester of the 3rd Year of their undergraduate study, student must choose from different areas of concentration: 1. traditional Chinese pharmaceuticals, 2. analysis of Chinese material medica, 3. biotechnology of Chinese materia medica. Upon graduation, students must have completed core courses, lab courses, practicum and thesis writing.3.Course Offering: Basics Biology &Chemistry Core Advanced MathematicsLinear Algebra Probability& StatisticsPhysicsCollege EnglishLaw Basics Computer BasicsProgramming Language Inorganic Chemistry Analytical Chemistry Organic Chemistry Physical ChemistryBiochemistryMicrobiology Introduction to TCMElementary BiologyPharmaceutical BotanyMedicinal animalsPhysiology and Ecology of PlantsPharmacognosyCultivation of Medicinal PlantsResource of Chinese Medicinal MaterialsMedicinal Chemistry of Natural ProductsPhytochemotaxonomyAnalysis/Biotechnology/Pharmacology /Processing of Chinese Materia MedicaIntroduction to the Development of New TCMPharmaceutical Law 4.Starting Date: September 1 to 5, 2011 Application Deadline: July 15th, 2011 Notes: Those who miss the application deadline can submit your application materials before September 1st, 2011 at the latest.
